title: Shonen Jump’s Newest Sensation Continues Its Rise With a New Milestone
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump may be seeing frequent cancellations of newer series while several long-running titles are also nearing their end. However, amid this transition, a select few manga continue to thrive and establish themselves as the magazine’s leading titles.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump to Cancel Yet Another Major 2026 Series
content: These days, while shonen franchises like One Piece and Dragon Ball continue to make waves in the anime industry, not all is well in the pages of Weekly Shonen Jump . title: Scriptwriter Hiroyuki Kawasaki Dies
content: Kawasaki was born on November 17, 1965. Kawasaki had written scripts for numerous anime, including Blade of the Immortal , Ryoko's Case File , Silent Möbius , After War Gundam X , and Sakura Wars .
author: ANN

title: GKIDS Screens Adolescence of Utena Anime Film in U.S. Theaters on June 21-22
content: GKIDS announced on Thursday that it has acquired the North American theatrical rights for Adolescence of Utena , the 1999 anime film for the Revolutionary Girl Utena series, and it will screen the movie in Japanese with English subtitles in U.S. theaters on June 21-22. Tickets are on sale .
author: ANN

title: The Simpsons Announces New Summer Episodes (But Some Fans Might Not be Happy)
content: The Simpsons brought its thirty-seventh season to an end earlier this February, giving animation enthusiasts a shorter season that ultimately released fifteen episodes in total.

title: Tomb Raider King Korean-Animated Series Reveals New Character Videos, July 8 Debut
content: Kadokawa revealed the July 8 debut for the Korean-animated adaptation of artist 3B2S , storywriter Yuns (REDICE STUDIO), original storywriter SAN.G , and character designer P-crush 's Tomb Raider King webtoon on Thursday.

title: Invincible Actor Doesn’t Know Why He Was Recast
content: Invincible’s fourth season saw Mark fighting the Viltrumite Empire, travelling to the underworld, and struggling to keep his soul in the face of terrifying decisions made to protect his world. Unfortunately, not every cast member of the animated series will continue being a part of Grayson’s world.

title: Detective Conan, Star Detective Precure! Anime Preview Crossover Episodes in Trailer
content: The official YouTube channel for the Detective Conan anime began streaming on Thursday a promotional video for the upcoming collaboration crossover episodes with the Star Detective Precure! anime: The episode of Detective Conan airing on June 6, "Hanamaru na Answer" (The Flower Seal Answer), will feature Cure Answer.
